_how: This file is the heart of Nashat VPN's country list. Host it in your GitHub repo (NashatShamsadyn7/nashat-vpn → directory/servers.json). Every installed app fetches it on launch and shows these locations as countries with flags. To add a country: install your VPS with server/install.sh, paste the printed vless:// link below under a new location, commit. All apps update themselves.
